training: All240 approved dense pure-training people and all76 descendants from25 whole training families; no evaluation people or evaluation founders
reference: Existing3033 identity-disjoint people only; cap16 per authoritative fine population, with a deterministic broad-source-count-matched hash control
density: Exact existing masks plus spatial thinning of Frederik to the retained Lonni count on each chromosome; no new alleles, imputation or truth-dependent markers
phase: Singleton phase-only processing against the full3033 reference on each exact panel, once per person/panel/chromosome; hold these haplotypes fixed across inference-reference contrasts
filtering: Preserve parent full-reference MAF/MAC filtering and physical spans across inference-reference subsets; do not re-filter markers per candidate
initialization: Fresh native reference-only p/rho/theta per panel/reference/chromosome; explicit T10 and uniform priors; paired fixed/singleton-EM runs, update-p=false; no source anchoring, calibrator or target truth supplied
truth: Pure source labels and exact chromosome-specific half-open pedigree segments, full physical spans, both haplotypes equally weighted
smoke: chr22, all three panels/six native configurations/two phases, one hash-selected SAS training donor and one training descendant with maximum chr22 source count; never choose by prediction error
reporting: Separate chromosome/panel/phase/track; TV, tails, max component error,5/10pp coverage, zero-truth off-target mass, family-balanced and pure-source-balanced means, fine-population diagnostics and runtime
selection: Exploratory reference-only model screening, not a supervised donor-purged calibration CV or certification; no automatic winner or production promotion; lock finalists before all-autosome development follow-up
gnomix: Retain prior genuine Gnomix baselines; refit on exact matching panels for subsequent locked finalist comparison, never reuse an incompatible panel model
pipeline_position: Raw compatible methods, phase-only and phased+imputed tracks remain permitted; this experiment isolates inference reference, marker density and phase, not imputation
